text.title: Google Performance Max Failure Modes
text.summary: 4 antipatterns observed in real google-pmax engagements — launch below the data floor, brand cannibalization, single asset group, audience signals treated as hard limits. Each pairs a symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: PMax launched with 8 conv/mo; budget consumed in 'Other' bucket; no insight.
antipattern.fix: Pause; route budget to Search + Shopping until ≥30 conv/mo.

antipattern.symptom: Brand CPA up 50%; PMax shows on brand queries.
antipattern.root-cause: Brand negatives not added at account level.
antipattern.fix: Add brand keyword list as PMax-level negatives; monitor brand Search recover within 2 weeks.

antipattern.symptom: One asset group across all products; cannot diagnose anything.
antipattern.fix: Split into ≥3 themed asset groups (audience or product line).

antipattern.symptom: Using audience signals as the only targeting control and expecting PMax to respect them as hard limits.

root-cause.source: Google Ads PMax audience signals docs

antipattern.root-cause: Audience signals guide the optimizer but do not restrict inventory. PMax will bid outside the signal audiences if the optimizer finds higher conversion probability elsewhere.
antipattern.fix: Treat signals as hints; control reach with brand negatives, url_expansion_opt_out, and themed asset groups, and read placement reports weekly.
